title: French-Style Papa Rellena
description: A crispy Peruvian-inspired potato dish with a French twist.

ingredients.name: ground beef
ingredients.notes: or ground pork, beef, and pork mix

instructions: 1. Preheat oil in a large skillet to 350°F (175°C).
2. Peel the potatoes and boil them in salted water until they're cooked through.
3. Mash the potatoes in a bowl and let them cool.
4. Add ground beef, cumin, paprika, garlic, and onion to the mashed potatoes. Mix well.
5. Add beaten eggs and mix until just combined.
6. If using, add chopped cilantro and mix.
7. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate the mixture for at least 30 minutes.
8. When ready to fry, form the mixture into patties.
9. Dredge each patty in bread crumbs (if using).
10. Fry the patties until golden brown and crispy.
11. Remove from oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
